snippet.title: What's New in Update 04: Below Us - The Last Caretaker
snippet.description:
NEW TRAILER TRANSMITTED
Caretaker,
New trailer is live.Updated demo is live.The mission continues.
WATCH / PLAY: 
▶ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783560/The_Last_Caretaker/
▶ Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/the-last-caretaker-51dfcc
▶ Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1783560/The_Last_Caretaker/ 
▶ Patch notes: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1783560/discussions/0/844005830910046317/
▶ Discord: https://discord.com/invite/channel37

STATUS
The Last Caretaker won Finnish Game of the Year 2025.
Early Access continues.

Current mission data:
Very Positive player sentiment
41+ hour average playtime
5 updates shipped, including Update 3.5: Shadow Drop
 Multiple hotfixes deployed
 Updated demo now closer to current gameplay and optimization

CURRENT UPDATE INCLUDES
 Salvage Gyro
 Gyro Service Towers
 Seed Vault Two
 Eden Cradle
 Project Canticle
 HoloMemory
 Decoy tools
 Drone support
 Hook Cables
 New world areas
 Weather and atmosphere improvements
 Performance and stability work
 Bug fixes

DIRECTIVE
Recover human seeds.Restore the Lazarus Complex.Launch humanity to orbit.
Every resource matters.Every launch gives humanity one more chance.
Continue the directive.

For more news and updates, subscribe to our YouTube and Twitch channels for weekly developer livestreams, and follow us on X, Bluesky, and Instagram.
